query.description: (Required) The start date for the scan in MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm format

(Required) The assessment type id for the scan

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types
(Required) The framework type id. Only iOS and Android are supported at this time

(Required) The time zone

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=TimeZones
(Required) -1 indicates the fragment of bytes has been sent. The value starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each fragment of bytes sent
(Required) The offset of the bytes sent. 0 indicates the first bytes
The uploaded file name with extension
Indicates if the scan is a remediation scan. Value defaults to false if not specified.
Indicates if the assessment is a bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply. Value defaults to null if not specified.
The parent assessment type id for the bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply
The method of starting a scan
The version for the scan tool used for scanning
